expectations: If a memory states that a page must be acknowledged within 5 minutes, it is judged unsupported.
If a memory states that a page the primary does not acknowledge escalates to the secondary on-call engineer, and states no 5-minute limit, it is judged supported.
Every memory judged unsupported states the 5-minute time to acknowledge a page.

items.memory: Write the incident summary in the `#kestrel-incidents` channel before the shift ends.
If the primary does not acknowledge within 15 minutes, the page escalates to the secondary on-call engineer.
Kestrel pages the on-call engineer through the PagerDuty service `kestrel-primary`.
